name: Clear Icon Cache
description: Removes the Windows icon cache to fix missing or outdated icons in File Explorer and on your desktop without deleting installed apps.

description_i18n.en: Removes the Windows icon cache to fix missing or outdated icons in File Explorer and on your desktop without deleting installed apps.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt den Windows-Icon-Cache, um fehlende oder veraltete Icons im Datei-Explorer und auf dem Desktop zu beheben, ohne installierte Apps zu löschen.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime le cache des icônes de Windows pour corriger les icônes manquantes ou obsolètes dans l'Explorateur et sur votre bureau sans supprimer d'applications.

warnings.title: Explorer refresh
warnings.message: Windows Explorer will close briefly during execution, causing File Explorer windows to disappear temporarily. Icons may appear blank or load slowly while Windows rebuilds the database

warnings.title: Local data cleanup
warnings.message: Cache and temporary icon files will be removed. Windows or apps may take a moment to rebuild them

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Deletes the IconCache.db file from your user profile and removes iconcache* files in the Explorer folder The script stops and restarts Windows Explorer to force a rebuild of the cache
